claim: A council review round runs on a draft PR as its medium: findings and responses are PR review comments, never files committed to the tree; the only artifacts that land in the repo are the distilled plan and the code. The medium is never `main` and never a replay of a round that already happened elsewhere.

evidence.detail: Staged and grounded in the council-mechanism proto-belief document: a council folder of committed analyses is a shadow graph (a handoff store by another name); the PR comment lane keeps review noise discoverable but out of the tree, consistent with the merge-commit-only curated-artifact ethos.
Deliberation thread: the operator-in-the-loop session that designed the council mechanism and rejected the committed-files medium.

Session thread retro-pair (cb:b507): the minting session's finalized thread persists at the cited document - the A2 enactment that minted the four council-mechanism rows through clean preflights alongside the route-tagging enactment, and held council-mechanism live in the nursery (rows planted, /council build and Open strands unresolved) on the cb:b569 graduation call.
